), live_relations AS (
	SELECT c.oid, c.relname, c.relkind FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
	JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
	WHERE n.nspname = current_schema()
), live_columns AS (
	SELECT r.relname AS table_name, a.attname AS column_name, a.atttypid, NOT a.attnotnull AS nullable
	FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a JOIN live_relations r ON r.oid = a.attrelid
	WHERE r.relkind = 'r' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
)
SELECT 'column' AS object, e.table_name || '.' || e.column_name AS name,
	CASE WHEN l.column_name IS NULL THEN 'missing'
		WHEN l.atttypid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_regtype(e.type_name) THEN 'type is ' || pg_catalog.format_type(l.atttypid, NULL) || ', expected ' || e.type_name
		ELSE 'nullable is ' || l.nullable || ', expected ' || e.nullable END AS problem
FROM expected_columns e
LEFT JOIN live_columns l ON l.table_name = e.table_name AND l.column_name = e.column_name
WHERE l.column_name IS NULL OR l.atttypid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_regtype(e.type_name) OR l.nullable <> e.nullable
UNION ALL
SELECT 'index', e.index_name, 'missing' FROM expected_indexes e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_relations r WHERE r.relkind = 'i' AND r.relname = e.index_name)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'constraint', e.table_name || '.' || e.constraint_name, 'missing' FROM expected_constraints e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
	SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint k JOIN live_relations r ON r.oid = k.conrelid
	WHERE r.relname = e.table_name AND k.conname = e.constraint_name
)
ORDER BY 1, 2
